messages:
Nina PM: Quick sync on compact keys UI. Goal: make rotate first-class, keep revoke recoverable. Prototype uploaded. Feedback?

Eli (Design): Side panel prototype: rows with label, last-used, actions. Soft-revoke shows inline "undo available" countdown badge. Empty state CTA centered.

Rahul (Eng): Backend note: per-row live countdown is heavy. Recommend rendering expiry timestamp and only run client countdown for visible items. Default soft-delete TTL = 24h.

Mika (a11y): a11y: use role=dialog for panel, trap focus, aria-live='polite' for toasts. Don't update SR every second; only update when minutes change. Undo must be keyboard accessible.

Nina PM: Product decision: default TTL 24h, org-level override to make permanent immediate revoke. Show clear label: "Undo available for 24 hours".

Eli (Design): Copy tweak: "Revoke will stop calls immediately" vs "Disable the key". Lean to "Disable" to reduce panic. Also add microcopy: "Rotate first: create replacement then revoke."

Rahul (Eng): Security: don't inject secrets into DOM until reveal. Show for 8 seconds, audit log reveal, rate-limit copy.

Mika (a11y): When secret is revealed, focus the field and provide aria-describedby "secret-visible-for-8-seconds". Escape should re-mask.

Nina PM: Telemetry ask: track revoke->undo rate, reveal->copy, and rotate uptake. We'll use to tune TTL and copy.

Eli (Design): Will add compact density mode for >50 keys and wire the soft-revoke states.

Rahul (Eng): Plan: feature flag rollout + canary. Implement server TTL, client countdown for visible rows, new batch perms endpoint.

Mika (a11y): I'll draft test cases and expected announcements.

Nina PM: Great, follow-up next Tue. Thanks :rocket:
